page_title: MON 2-0 TOU | Monaco v Toulouse 07/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+1' Jordan Teze (Monaco) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Toulouse take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
88' Substitution. Christian Mawissa Elebi (Monaco) has come on for Caio Henrique.
88' A substitution has been made. Vanderson goes off and Jordan Teze (Monaco) comes on.
87' The substitution has been made. Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse) has replaced Djibril Sidibe.
87' Carles Martinez prepares a substitution. Cristian Casseres is replaced by Miha Zajc (Toulouse).
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Frank Magri (Toulouse) replaces Aron Donnum.
86' The resulting set piece from Toulouse is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

82' 2 - 0 Breel Embolo (Monaco) gets to the ball inside the penalty area and produces a bullet header towards the goal. He aims his effort nicely under the crossbar, leaving Guillaume Restes helpless. He makes it 2:0.
82' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) comes onto the pitch for Takumi Minamino.
76' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar.
76' Monaco have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
75' Carles Martinez has decided to make a change. Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) replaces Yann Gboho.
74' Joshua King (Toulouse) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
71' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Cristian Casseres (Toulouse).
70' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Vincent Sierro walks off the pitch to be replaced by Niklas Schmidt (Toulouse).
69' Breel Embolo (Monaco) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
68' Breel Embolo (Monaco) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
63' Adi Hutter decides to make a substitution. George Ilenikhena will be replaced by Breel Embolo (Monaco).
63' The manager makes a subsitution with Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) coming on for Eliot Matazo.
63' Wilfried Singo (Monaco) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Stephanie Frappart who sees an offensive foul.
62' The corner is swung in but Monaco can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
60' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) makes a good run to meet a precise cross just outside the box. He latches on to it and strikes the ball, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save.
56' Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
54' Joshua King (Toulouse) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.

50' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Maghnes Akliouche flights the free kick into the box, where Wilfried Singo (Monaco) peels off his marker and heads straight inside the upright from the edge of the six-yard box. He makes it 1:0.
50' Lamine Camara (Monaco) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
49' Dangerous play by Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse). Stephanie Frappart blows his whistle for a foul.
48' Wilfried Singo (Monaco) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
48' Wilfried Singo (Monaco) picks up an injury.
47' A lofted cross from Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.

46' What a chance that is! George Ilenikhena (Monaco) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Stephanie Frappart blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
43' Foul! Mark McKenzie (Toulouse) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
41' Fine play by Takumi Minamino (Monaco) opens up space on the edge of the box for the shot, but his effort lacks accuracy and flies miles over the bar.
39' Guillaume Restes displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Takumi Minamino (Monaco) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
37' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) has tested the patience of referee Stephanie Frappart and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
35' George Ilenikhena (Monaco) squandered a big chance! He got to the rebound inside the box but his effort smashes against the crossbar!
34' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
30' Monaco are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
29' George Ilenikhena (Monaco) picks up a pass and unleashes a low shot towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Guillaume Restes.
17' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Toulouse.
14' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) displays brilliant individual ability, gets inside the box and pulls the trigger. His promising effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
6' The referee stops play as the linesman flags George Ilenikhena (Monaco) offside.
4' George Ilenikhena (Monaco) gets on the end of a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but it's a poor header and drifts high over the bar.
3' Vanderson (Monaco) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Toulouse will take the kick-off.
Stephanie Frappart will referee today's match.
